Identifying, assessing, and managing nontraditional security threat risks for individuals, organizations, and enterprises across multiple sectors.
Risk Analysis

Leading and commanding teams to carry out specialized missions in security situations. Motivating personnel and building a safe and effective working environment.
Team Leader

Researching, evaluating, and forecasting nontraditional security threat risks. Providing strategic advisory services to organizational and enterprise leadership.

Advising and developing risk prevention plans and nontraditional security crisis response plans tailored to specific sectors and organizational scales.

Career Opportunities After Graduation
BNS graduates can take on various positions in government agencies, enterprises, and the private sector. Source: BNS Program Proposal, HSB 2025.
Group 1
Specialized Government Agencies
Eligible to apply for research, teaching, and operational positions within ministries and government agencies at both central and local levels.
Ministry of Public Security
Ministry of National Defence
Ministry of Information & Communications
Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Group 2
Large Domestic & Foreign Enterprises
Specialist or assistant roles in risk management, general administration, and board secretariat departments at state-owned, FDI, and private enterprises.
Security Specialist
Risk Management
Executive Assistant
Administrative Management
Group 5
Entrepreneurship & Private Security
Establishing and managing professional security companies and nontraditional security services for households and high-profile individuals.
Security Company
Security Services
Risk Consulting
Startup
In addition:
Group 3
– Community security personnel under the Law on Forces Participating in the Protection of Security and Public Order (commune/ward/township level);
Group 4
– Assistants/specialists at administrative agencies and non-governmental organizations.
After 10–20 years of accumulated experience, BNS graduates are projected to have opportunities to become senior experts or leaders in the field of nontraditional security across government agencies, organizations, and enterprises.
